Game Overview

In Animal World, the core idea is straightforward: dive into Animal World, a vibrant open-world adventure where you tame whimsical creatures, build cozy homes, and survive thrilling nights. Master crafting, explore vast landscapes, and power up your adventures with unique pets that lend a hand in gathering and battling as you uncover hidden treasures.
